text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black sets her sights on victory 
in the Tenno Sho (Spring). Training 
alongside Satono Diamond has pushed her 
skills even further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Cheval Grand had also built 
confidence through racing, learning to 
openly and honestly acknowledge the 
strength of other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when chatting with childhood friends, 
Cheval Grand genuinely respects Kitasan 
Black's sheer strength and brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
